text: I've been having headaches for the past few days.  i don't have fever. but i haven't been sleeping well. am i just tired?

Not necessarily. While fatigue can contribute to headaches, there could be other underlying causes. Can you tell me more about your headaches? Are they on one side of your head, or all over? Are they sharp pains or a dull ache?
the headaches are mostly on the front or top part of my head. it's rather dull

Okay, that's helpful to know. The fact that they're on the front or top part of your head, and are a dull ache, might suggest a few possible conditions. We should discuss them with a doctor to determine the cause. Would you like to see a primary care physician or a specialist, like a neurologist or a headache specialist?
i can search for headache specialist.  but what kind of questions should i ask?

Some questions you might want to ask the doctor include: What could be causing my headaches, and are they related to my sleep deprivation? Are there any tests or imaging studies that would be helpful in diagnosing the cause of my headaches? What are some potential treatment options, and are there any lifestyle changes I can make to help manage my headaches?
